issue.detail: Spec says conversion begins when Reset is released; contract does not specify whether the first posedge after release samples x in S0 (pass) or whether S0 is entered and first bit processed same cycle. Alternative: first released cycle is S0 and z=x same cycle.
issue.spec_evidence: The conversion begins when Reset is released and stops when Reset is asserted.
issue.alternative: On first posedge after areset deassert, state is S0 and z=x combinationally; S0->S1 if x=1 at that edge.

issue.detail: Spec says stops when Reset asserted; contract forces z=0 during reset, but does not state whether state must be S0 immediately on async assert (it does via R4) and whether output during reset is 0 vs last value. Alternative: z held last value during reset.
issue.alternative: During areset=1, z retains previous value instead of forced 0.
